entry.title: GBC Project is Now Open-Source!
entry.summary: 🎉 Exciting News! We're thrilled to announce that the GBC Project is now officially open-source and available on GitHub!
entry.content:
🎉 Exciting News! We're thrilled to announce that the GBC Project is now officially open-source and available on GitHub!

What's New​

The entire GBC (Generalized Biped Controller) project is now publicly available, allowing researchers and developers worldwide to:

  • Access the complete codebase for humanoid robot motion planning
  • Contribute to the development of advanced imitation learning algorithms
  • Build upon our work for their own robotics projects
  • Join our growing community of robotics enthusiasts

Key Features Available​

✅ Advanced Retargeting Networks - Map any SMPL+H motion to your humanoid robot
✅ Hybrid RL Algorithms - Combine imitation learning with reinforcement learning
✅ Multi-Robot Support - Works with various humanoid architectures
✅ Isaac Lab Integration - Seamless integration with NVIDIA's Isaac Lab

Get Started​

Visit our GitHub repository to:

  • Clone the project
  • Check out the documentation
  • Start experimenting with your own humanoid robots

What's Next​

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to improve and expand the GBC ecosystem. We're excited to see what the community will build with these tools!

Have questions or want to contribute? Join the discussion on our GitHub Discussions page.
